description: Limits applied when a template enters the application: the size of the MJML input, the number of sections and blocks, and how deeply blocks may nest. They guard both the MJML importer and the JSON deserialization against a hostile or broken document (a "billion laughs" style tree, a runaway paste) and are reusable through EmailDocumentLimitsValidator before a document is saved.

members.name: MaxBlocks
members.description: Maximum number of blocks in the imported document, including blocks nested in hero, group and wrapper containers (default 2000). Exceeding it fails the import with TooManyBlocks.

members.name: MaxInputBytes
members.description: Maximum size of the input in UTF-8 bytes (not in characters), default 5 MB. Exceeding it fails the import with InputTooLarge instead of parsing the payload.

members.name: MaxNestingDepth
members.description: Maximum nesting depth of blocks (default 8). A block directly in a section column is depth 1 and every hero/group/wrapper level adds one — the same convention LayoutValidator uses. Exceeding it fails the import with TooDeeplyNested.

members.name: MaxSections
members.description: Maximum number of sections in the imported document, including sections nested inside a wrapper (default 200). Exceeding it fails the import with TooManySections.
